# Agent Arena

> Agent Arena is an open-source, browser-native multi-agent playground. You place LLM-powered characters on a 3D map (office, forest, or space), watch them idle-talk, and chat with them privately or in a shared arena. It runs entirely in the browser with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or Ollama — no Agent Arena backend.

Agent Arena is not a hosted multi-agent orchestration framework, not a Discord bot, and not a server-side agent runtime. It is a visual playground you run locally (`npm run dev`) or host statically (GitHub Pages). API keys stay in the browser (`localStorage`) and are sent only to the providers you configure. Code is MIT; bundled 3D assets remain CC0 / CC BY.

Early preview (`v0.1.0`). Map format (`aamf` v1) and UI may still change.
